ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90% low-intensity (dark) pixels with 10% high-intensity (white/light) pixels concentrated at the right distal margin and as scattered linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region located on the right lateral margin. Remainder of the visible fluke is occupied by low-intensity dark pigment with sparse, unaligned high-intensity linear disruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a visible depth-to-width ratio indicating a sharp angle, though the vertex is slightly occluded by water splashing.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations and variable amplitudes; significant jagged protrusions are visible at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory for both lobes sweeping from the center towards the lateral tips; right lobe shows more irregularity at the terminus.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, dark, textured nodes localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel high-intensity linear streaks (scars) visible on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations on the distal margins of both lobes, particularly dense on the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique jagged silhouette of the right lobe tip due to heavy biological growth.
